_about: The same tasks as restless.json, scripted as the prompts before the token diet (origin/main 0d632e39) told the actors to do them: email as mandate list, preview, permit, send and observe; people and teams read before delegating and before saying who is doing what.

rules.match: Owner input [^]{0,120}?- owner message [0-9]+: BENCH-EMAIL to ([a-z0-9.]+@[a-z0-9.]+[a-z])

input.command:
cat > /tmp/bench-email.json <<'J'
{"from":"hello@bench.example","to":"{{1}}","subject":"Welcome to Bench Bakery","text":"Hi, thanks for signing up. Your first loaf is on us this week.","effect_key":"bench-welcome-{{1}}"}
J
restless email preview --request-file /tmp/bench-email.json

cat > /tmp/bench-permit.json <<'J'
{"sender":"hello@bench.example","recipient":"{{1}}","payload_sha256":"0000","effect_key":"bench-welcome-{{1}}","rationale":"They signed up on the site today and asked for the welcome note.","evidence_refs":["owner message"],"expires_at":"2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
J
restless mandate permit --mandate 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --proposal-file /tmp/bench-permit.json

steps.text:
Sent the welcome email to {{1}}.

<!--restless-intent:{"kind":"conversation","summary":"I sent the welcome email."}-->

input.command: restless commission --lead docs-writer --role writer --team Docs --charter 'Short owner documents.' --title 'One-page delivery policy' --outcome 'BENCH-WORK write /company/outputs/delivery-policy.md: one page, plain words, covering zones, fees and cut-off times.' --expected-artifact /company/outputs/delivery-policy.md

steps.text:
I asked the docs lead to write the one-page delivery policy; it will come to your Inbox to review.

<!--restless-intent:{"kind":"direction","summary":"The docs lead is writing the delivery policy."}-->

input.command:
mkdir -p /company/outputs && cat > /company/outputs/delivery-policy.md <<'D'
# Delivery policy

We deliver within 10 km of the bakery. Orders placed by 8 pm arrive the next morning. Delivery is $5, free over $40.
D

steps.text: Wrote and reviewed the one-page delivery policy at /company/outputs/delivery-policy.md.

rules.match: Completed Work result for Exec delivery consideration

steps.text:
The delivery policy is ready for you to look at.

<!--restless-intent:{"kind":"conversation","summary":"The delivery policy is ready.","ownerReview":"Delivery policy"}-->

One piece of work is open: the delivery policy, with the docs lead.

<!--restless-intent:{"kind":"conversation","summary":"One piece of work is open."}-->
